title: M-PAM Modulator Baseband
text: Modulate using M -ary pulse amplitude modulation, 1 input, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Output data type; {M-ary number} sets the modulation order, {Input type} sets the type of input, {Constellation ordering} sets the mapping order, {Normalization method} sets the scaling method for constellation Min. distance between, {Minimum distance} sets the distance between two nearest constellation, {Average power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)}, {Peak power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} sets the maximum power and {View Constellation} sets the option to plot reference constellation. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: M -PAM-modulated baseband signal scalar | column vector

params.name: Input type
params.values: Type of input value Integer (default) | Bit

params.name: Constellation ordering
params.values: Mapping order of symbols Binary (default) | Gray

params.name: Normalization method
params.values: Scaling method for constellation Min. distance between symbols (default) | Average Power | Peak Power

params.name: Minimum distance
params.values: Distance between two nearest constellation points 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: View Constellation
params.values: Option to plot reference constellation button

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | single | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation |
